research.notes: OUSD records show an Oakland, CA unarmed campus-security vendor named Elite Security Services. The only company with a website under that name is Elite Security Services & Solutions, LLC (Upper Marlboro, MD, hospital security), which does not match Oakland. Several other Elite-named security firms exist. Job-board listings show an Oakland (94604) 'Elite Security Services' hiring de-escalation-focused officers, but no website, registry entry or other identifying page was found.
